scope: Original Nivo raw-link shallow preparation, computed-link augmentation, SVG layer gate, NetworkLinks createElement/style/transition recipes, default NetworkLink JSX and record-only Canvas commands. Input positions/index/computed node styles authored, hook/color/transition/scalar/JSX dependencies explicitly synchronous probes. No force, React, Spring, native Canvas property-validation, browser events or pixels executed.

execution.defaults.ts:commonDefaultProps:
const commonDefaultProps: Omit<
    NetworkCommonProps<InputNode, InputLink>,
    | 'margin'
    | 'theme'
    | 'onClick'
    | 'renderWrapper'
    | 'ariaLabel'
    | 'ariaLabelledBy'
    | 'ariaDescribedBy'
> & {
    layers: LayerId[]
} = {
    layers: ['links', 'nodes', 'annotations'],

    linkDistance: 30,
    centeringStrength: 1,
    repulsivity: 10,
    distanceMin: 1,
    distanceMax: Infinity,
    iterations: 120,

    nodeSize: 12,
    activeNodeSize: 18,
    inactiveNodeSize: 8,
    nodeColor: '#000000',
    nodeBorderWidth: 0,
    nodeBorderColor: { from: 'color' },

    linkThickness: 1,
    linkColor: { from: 'source.color' },

    isInteractive: true,

boundaries.eligibility: links layer plus non-null computed links; empty array creates0; zero thickness/transparent/self/parallel/offviewport links not filtered. isInteractive is not a LinkProps field and does not gate link components.
boundaries.identity: Original id source.id+dot+target.id collides for parallel links and dotted endpoint names; recorded without repairing original behavior. Rust force-link:index has distinct index-slot semantics and is not stable edge identity across reorder.
boundaries.animation: initial/enter/update full endpoints opacity1; from source-to-source opacity0; no explicit leave property on original useTransition config. No retirement/runtime animation claim.
boundaries.props: Exactly key,link,animated,blendMode; no original link mouse handlers. Link owns original shallow-cloned data and computed endpoints/index/styles.
boundaries.canvas: Actual default function sets strokeStyle and lineWidth then beginPath/moveTo/lineTo/stroke; it does not set globalAlpha,lineCap or blend. Probe records commands, not native Canvas behavior; invalid native assignments such as zero width are not emulated.
